messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — I'm planning a targeted CRM prune of stale contact attributes tomorrow 08:00 PT. This will remove legacy 'trial_tag_v1' and empty secondary_email fields. Need a quick safety gate and owner OKs before we run.

tony_ops: Scope? which environments and expected row counts?

maria_cs: Only prod write for contacts dataset. Estimated ~4.2k rows affected (mostly imported legacy). No account deletes.

jules_se: Quick dry-run SQL I used to sample — run on staging then prod dry-run:```sql
SELECT id, account_id, updated_at, trial_tag_v1
FROM contacts
WHERE trial_tag_v1 IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 100;
```

rebecca_csm: I'm fine with removing trial_tag_v1. Question on secondary_email: some enablement flows surface it for reminders. Any tickets referencing it?

maria_cs: Checked analytics: secondary_email usage <0.1% of flows. I opened a lookup: https://go.company/internal/reports/secondary-email-usage (internal). No active tickets.

tony_ops: Can we add a quick sentinel to rollback if request failures spike? Idea: run batch with a canary of 100 rows, monitor 5xx and onboarding-failure metric for 15m before full rollout.

jules_se: +1. Canary script (dry-run mode):```bash
# canary purge
python tools/crm_prune.py --limit 100 --dry-run
# watch logs: kubectl logs -f deployment/crm-pruner | grep purge
```

maria_cs: Plan: 08:00 PT canary 100 rows dry-run, 08:20 review metrics, 08:30 run full prune with 2-minute slow ramp and alerts. I'll add a manual hold.

rebecca_csm: I'll notify enablement and customer owners with a short note — asking for any objections by EOD.

tony_ops: I'll wire an automated safety check; if onboarding-failures OR api-5xx go > 0.5% over baseline we'll abort and run rollback to rehydrate fields.

sam_bot: deploy:scheduled crm-pruner v1.4 -> prod in 9h (ID: deploy-9021). Creator: jules_se.

maria_cs: Thanks. If no objections, I'll mark this as go and attach the runbook + rollback steps. Ping me if you want a short walk-through pre-run. :thumbsup:
